You have learned about logic functions and logic gates..........
INTRODUCTIONM
The AND gate, by itself, performs only the AND function...........
However, combining the AND gate and the NOT gate performs the NAND function.
Many functions require the use of several gates in combination. Circuits used to add binary numbers use AND, OR and NOT gates.
This lesson introduces you to how individual gates are combined to form combinational logic.
Let's begin the lesson on INTRODUCTION TO COMBINATIONAL CIRCUITS............
LESSON MENU
COMBINATIONAL LOGIC
Combination logic is the combining of two or more logic gates....
DISCUSSION
Logic gates can be combined on ICs so that a single IC performs many different functions.
Manufacturers build ICs with the gates needed to perform all the functions required from that IC.
The way the IC is connected externally and internally determines what functions are available.

UNIVERSAL LOGIC GATES
Universal logic gates are gates that can be connected in a way to produce the logic functions of other gates.
DISCUSSION
The NAND and NOR gates are commonly used as universal logic gates.
